title: Niagara Falls Small-Group Tour with Niagara Takes Flight
includes: Stand at the brink of Horseshoe Falls
Guided Walk along Niagara Parkway to Horseshoe Falls
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Niagara Falls on a guided walking tour that combines breathtaking viewpoints with a unique immersive attraction. Begin near Clifton Hill and enjoy a fully narrated walk along the Niagara Parkway, passing through beautiful gardens and scenic lookout points.
Take in views of the American Falls, Bridal Veil Falls, and the iconic Horseshoe Falls before arriving at Table Rock Welcome Centre. Your experience concludes with timed admission to Niagara Takes Flight, an exciting flying theatre that showcases Niagara from a whole new perspective.
This small-group tour offers the perfect combination of storytelling, scenery, and a one-of-a-kind attraction.
